DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about the water point?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。弁当の容器をここで洗ってよいか聞きたいです。飲み水の場所かもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 公共水場で容器を洗えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I would like to ask whether I can wash my lunch container here. This might be a drinking water point.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may wash a container at a public water point. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 用途の表示を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the sign indicating its use.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。水が出るからといって、食べ物の残りを流してよいとは考えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 水の有無と食品残り排水を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please do. I do not assume that just because water comes out, it is all right to wash food scraps down the drain.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the availability of water from draining food scraps. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今はまだ洗っていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Have you refrained from washing it so far?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。残りは袋へ入れました。容器も持ち帰れるので、洗わずに済ませられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未洗浄で持帰りの準備ありと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I put the leftovers in a bag. I can also take the container home, so I can manage without washing it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not washed it and are prepared to take it home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 水場の前を空けてお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please wait with the area in front of the water point clear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 横へ移ります。水を飲む方が来たら、先に使えるようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 脇へ移り飲水利用者を優先する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will move to the side. If someone comes for a drink, I will let them use it first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Move aside and give priority to people using the drinking water. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 管理の案内では、ここは飲水用です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: According to the management's guidance, this is for drinking water.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。容器は家へ持ち帰り、ここでは洗い物をしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 飲水用途の回答を受け持帰りを選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will take the container home and will not wash dishes here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After learning that it is for drinking water, choose to take the container home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご協力ありがとうございます。残りと容器を袋に入れ、足元もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15223-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for your cooperation. Put the leftovers and container in a bag, and check the ground around your feet too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 船の到着後の移動でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about getting to your destination after the ferry arrives?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。迎えに来る家族へ、船が着く時刻だけ伝えました。降りて会える時刻も考えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 船到着と家族への集合時刻を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I only told the family member picking me up what time the ferry arrives. I would also like to consider what time I can disembark and meet them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss the ferry's arrival and the meeting time with your family. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 大きな荷物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have any large luggage?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: スーツケースがあります。船が着いた瞬間に、外の車へ乗れるとは限りませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 荷物があり即乗車できるとは限らないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have a suitcase. Arriving at the dock does not necessarily mean I can immediately get into the car outside, does it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you have luggage and may not be able to get into the car immediately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 降りてから荷物を持ち、集合先へ移動する時間も必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: You also need time after disembarking to collect your luggage and get to the meeting point.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家族には到着後の案内を見てから連絡します。急いで駐車場所を変えてもらうのは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 到着後案内確認から連絡し車を急に動かさない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will contact my family after checking the instructions following arrival. I would like to avoid asking them to change parking spots in a hurry.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Contact your family after checking the arrival instructions, without making them move the car in a hurry. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 集合場所の目印は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you decided on a landmark for the meeting point?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 案内窓口の前です。車の列へ自分で出て探すのではなく、歩いて行ける場所で合流します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 歩行可能な窓口前集合を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: In front of the information counter. Instead of going out into the queue of cars to look for them myself, I will meet them somewhere I can reach on foot.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Specify a meeting in front of the counter, somewhere accessible on foot. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 遅れが出た場合も連絡できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Can you also contact them if there is a delay?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。船の到着予定と、私が外へ出たことを別々に知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 船予定と本人退出済みを別連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will tell them the ferry's expected arrival time and that I have come outside in separate messages.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Send separate updates about the ferry's schedule and your having come outside. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 到着後の表示をご確認ください。安全に歩いて集合先へ向かい、家族へ位置をお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check the signs after arrival. Walk safely to the meeting point and tell your family where you are.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 書類についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to ask about documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。旅行で滞在していますが、自分の住民手続きの書類を問い合わせたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 旅行中の住民手続書類を問い合わせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I am here on a trip, but I would like to inquire about documents for my own resident registration procedures.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Inquire about resident registration documents while traveling. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 普段お住まいの住所は別の地域ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is your usual home address in a different area?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。ホテルは今の連絡先です。そこへ住民登録を移したいという相談ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 居住地とホテル連絡先を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. The hotel is my current contact address. I am not asking about moving my resident registration there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish your home address from the hotel contact address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当する地域と、問い合わせの方法を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check which area's office is responsible and how to contact them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。旅行先でどの書類でも発行できると思っているわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 旅行先で全書類発行可と思わないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. It is not that I think every kind of document can be issued at my travel destination.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you do not assume all documents can be issued at your travel destination. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な書類名は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you know the name of the document you need?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 住所に関する証明です。正式な名前と必要項目を提出先へ聞いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 正式書類名と必要項目を提出先へ確認中と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is a certificate relating to my address. I am asking the organization I will submit it to for the official name and required details.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you are checking the official document name and required details with the recipient. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 住所地の担当へ相談する準備をご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can explain how to prepare to consult the office responsible for your home address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。書類名が分かってから住所地へ連絡し、ホテルへ届く方法が使えるかは別に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 住所地相談と滞在先受取方法を別確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. Once I know the document's name, I will contact the office for my home address, and separately ask whether a method for delivery to my hotel is available.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check separately about consulting your home address office and receiving the document at your temporary accommodation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 住民手続きの住所と滞在中の連絡先を分けて、担当へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please distinguish your address for resident procedures from your contact address during your stay when speaking to the responsible office.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どのような具合ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 船で気分が悪くなり、降りた後も吐き気が続いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 船内から下船後も続く吐気を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I started feeling sick on the ferry, and I have continued to feel nauseous even after disembarking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that nausea has continued from the ferry ride through after disembarkation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 降りてからどのくらいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: How long has it been since you disembarked?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二時間です。船を降りればすぐ治ると思いましたが、まだ続いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 下船後二時間で症状継続と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Two hours. I thought I would recover as soon as I got off the ferry, but it is still continuing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that the symptoms are continuing two hours after disembarkation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 何か薬を飲みましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 乗る前に市販の薬を飲みました。この箱の薬です。普段の薬もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 市販酔止めと常用薬の両方を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I took an over-the-counter medicine before boarding. It is the medicine in this box. I also have my regular medication.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show both your over-the-counter motion sickness medicine and regular medication. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 両方を担当へお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please show both to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。酔いの薬だけを飲んだとは伝えず、常用薬も手帳で示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 服薬情報を省かず手帳も提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will not say that I only took motion sickness medicine; I will also show my regular medication in my medication record book.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not omit medication information, and present your medication record book too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ほかの変化もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Have you noticed any other changes?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 少しふらつきます。今の症状と薬の時刻を説明し、追加の薬を自分で決めず診察を受けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: ふらつき服用時刻を伝え自己追加せず受診する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I feel a little unsteady. I will explain my current symptoms and when I took the medicines, and see a doctor without deciding on extra medication myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report unsteadiness and medication times, and seek medical attention without adding medication yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 薬の箱と手帳をお持ちください。症状の経過を担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please bring the medicine box and your medication record book. I will tell the person in charge how your symptoms have progressed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: なくした荷物の届出ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。小さい鞄をなくしました。今日は帰るので、後日連絡できる先も伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 帰宅当日の鞄紛失と後日連絡希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I lost a small bag. I am going home today, so I would also like to provide contact details I can be reached at later.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report losing a bag on the day you go home and ask to be contacted later. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 宿泊先の電話以外に、ご本人の番号はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have your own phone number apart from your accommodation's number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この携帯です。ホテルにはもう泊まらないので、そこだけを連絡先にしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ホテルでなく継続利用携帯を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: This mobile number. I will no longer be staying at the hotel, so please do not make it my only contact point.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify the mobile phone you will continue to use, rather than the hotel. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 最後に見た場所と時刻を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell me where and when you last saw it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨日の午後、海辺の休憩所です。中に帰りの券は入っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 最後の場所時刻と帰り券は別と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yesterday afternoon, at the rest area by the sea. My return ticket is not inside it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the last location and time, and that your return ticket is separate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 鞄の特徴はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Does the bag have any distinguishing features?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 緑色で、側面に黄色い糸の補修があります。中の品も一覧にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 色補修と内容一覧を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is green, with a repair in yellow thread on the side. I will also make a list of the contents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Describe its color and repair, and provide a list of its contents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 帰宅後の受取方法は、見つかった時に相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: If it is found, you can discuss how to receive it after returning home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。今日見つかる前提で帰りの便を勝手に変えず、連絡方法を残して帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 帰便を未確定発見前提で変えず連絡を残す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will not change my return service on my own on the assumption that it will be found today; I will leave contact details and go home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Leave contact details without changing your return service on the assumption of an unconfirmed recovery. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 携帯番号と特徴を記録します。見つかった際の確認方法は担当からご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will record your mobile number and the bag's features. The person in charge will explain the verification process if it is found.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物を送られますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。家族へ土産を送ります。家族が受け取る箱だと分かるよう、控えを写真で送りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 土産箱の控え写真を家族へ共有したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I am sending souvenirs to my family. I would like to send them a photo of the receipt so they can recognize the box they will receive.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to share a photo of the souvenir parcel receipt with your family. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一つです。買った物の袋が三つありますが、送る箱は一箱にまとめました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 袋三つと発送箱一つを区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: One. I have three shopping bags, but I packed the items into one box for shipping.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish three bags from one shipping box. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 宛先と受取名は確認できていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Have you checked the delivery address and recipient's name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、母の名前と住所です。私の宿泊先を宛先として書かないよう確認しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 母の宛名住所と宿泊先を取り違えないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, my mother's name and address. I checked to make sure I did not write my accommodation as the delivery address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will not confuse your mother's name and address with your accommodation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 発送後に番号をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the number after shipment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。送る前の手書きメモではなく、実際に発行された番号を家族へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 実発行番号を共有すると頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please. I will tell my family the number actually issued, rather than the handwritten note from before shipping.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to share the number actually issued. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 配達日についてご希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do you have a preferred delivery date?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 急ぎません。予定日が案内されても、受取済みと同じ意味で伝えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予定日と受取完了を分けて家族へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: There is no rush. Even if I am given an expected delivery date, I will take care not to tell them it means the parcel has already been received.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish the expected delivery date from completed receipt when informing your family. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 一箱で受け付けます。控えの番号と宛先をご確認のうえ、家族へお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will accept it as one box. Please check the number and address on the receipt, then let your family know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お口座の手続きでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about a procedure for your bank account?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この口座は別の地域で作りました。旅行中のこちらの窓口でも相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 別地域開設口座の旅行先相談可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I opened this account in another area. Can I also ask at this branch while I am traveling here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can consult a branch at your travel destination about an account opened elsewhere. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの手続きをご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: What procedure would you like to carry out?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 登録した電話番号の更新です。現金を引き出すだけの相談ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 電話更新で現金引出しとは別と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Updating my registered phone number. I am not simply asking about withdrawing cash.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to update your phone number, which is separate from withdrawing cash. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この口座で対応できる手続きを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check which procedures we can handle for this account.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。ATMが使えるので窓口の手続きも全部同じと思い込んでいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ATM利用と全窓口手続きを区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. Since I can use the ATM, I had assumed all counter procedures would be the same too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish ATM use from all counter procedures. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 新しい番号を確認できる資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have any documents confirming the new number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 携帯の契約資料です。本人の資料と一緒に見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 新番号契約と本人資料を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: My mobile phone contract documents. I will show them along with my identity documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Present the contract showing the new number and your identity documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認してから必要な準備をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: After checking, I will explain what you need to prepare.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。ここでできなければ口座の窓口へ確認し、旅行先で手続き済みとは伝えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 不可なら元窓口へ相談し完了扱いしないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. If it cannot be done here, I will check with the branch for my account, and I will not say the procedure has been completed at my travel destination.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that if it cannot be done, you will consult the original branch and will not treat it as completed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 口座と本人資料を担当へお見せください。電話番号更新の対応範囲を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please show the person in charge your account and identity documents. We will check the scope of support for updating your phone number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ち帰りの予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you planning to take it home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。冷蔵の土産を買いたいです。船に乗っている時間だけ保冷できればよいと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 冷蔵土産の船旅保冷を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I would like to buy refrigerated souvenirs. I thought it would be enough to keep them cool only for the time on the ferry.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about keeping refrigerated souvenirs cool during a ferry journey. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 買ってから帰宅までの時間は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know the time from purchase until you get home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 乗るまでの待ち時間と、降りてからの電車もあります。全部で六時間くらいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 待機下船後も含む総六時間を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: There is the wait before boarding and the train after disembarking too. It is about six hours in total.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the total of six hours, including waiting and travel after disembarkation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 保冷用品と保存表示を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the cooling supplies and storage label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。船の中の時間だけでなく、買ってから冷蔵庫へ入れるまでで選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 購入から冷蔵庫までを保存時間にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will choose based on the time from purchase until putting them in the refrigerator, rather than just the time on the ferry.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Use the period from purchase until refrigeration as the storage time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご用意できる保冷の方法を担当へ聞けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can ask the person in charge what cooling methods are available.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。表示の条件に合わない場合は、冷蔵でない別の土産に変えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 保冷条件不適なら別土産へ変更希望を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please. If they do not meet the conditions on the label, I would like to switch to a different souvenir that does not need refrigeration.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to choose a different souvenir if the cooling conditions cannot be met. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 候補の商品はこちらです。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。合計時間と保存条件を比べ、無理なく持ち帰れる品を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 全行程と表示を照合して選択する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will compare the total travel time with the storage conditions and choose something I can reasonably take home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Compare the whole journey with the label when choosing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 商品の保存表示をご確認ください。ご予定を担当へ伝えてご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check the product's storage label. Tell the person in charge your plans and consult them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to ask something?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 地面に貝殻のような物があります。工作に使いたいですが、展示の一部かもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 貝殻様の物が展示か持帰可か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: There is something like a seashell on the ground. I would like to use it for crafts, but it might be part of a display.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a shell-like object is part of a display or may be taken home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 花壇の前です。まだ拾わずに、その位置の写真だけ撮りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 位置写真と未採取を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: In front of the flower bed. I have not picked it up; I only took a photo of its location.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have a photo of the location and have not collected it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 花壇の飾りかどうか管理担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check with the management staff whether it is a flower bed decoration.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。地面に落ちているから自由に持ってよいとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 落下物だから自由と決めないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I do not assume I may freely take it just because it is lying on the ground.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will not assume a fallen object is free to take. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 工作に必要な数は多いですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you need many for your craft project?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 数個です。持帰りができなくても、写真を見て自分で形を描く方法にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 必要数と不可時の写真描画の代替を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: A few. Even if I cannot take them home, I will use the photo to draw the shapes myself instead.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State the quantity needed and the alternative of drawing from the photo if taking them is not allowed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今ある物には触れずにお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please wait without touching the objects there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。場所を案内できるよう残して、担当の回答を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現物に触れず位置を残して回答を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will leave it in place so I can show where it is, and wait for the staff's answer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Wait for an answer without touching the object, leaving its position intact. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 写真と位置を担当へ伝えます。持帰りの可否を確認してからご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15224-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will tell the staff about the photo and location. We will explain after checking whether it may be taken home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: How many people are the tickets for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私と家族の二名です。私に使える割引が、家族にも使えるか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本人割引が家族にも使えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Two: myself and a family member. I would like to check whether the discount I qualify for also applies to my family member.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether your own discount also applies to your family member. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 割引の条件が分かる資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have documents showing the discount conditions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。自分の資料なので、家族も同じ対象だとはまだ確認していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人資料で家族資格は未確認と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here they are. These are my own documents, so I have not yet confirmed that my family member is also eligible.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the documents are yours and your family member's eligibility is unconfirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それぞれの条件を担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person in charge will check each person's conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。割引が使えない方は通常の券にして、本人の条件を混ぜないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 各条件別に通常券も選ぶと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please. For anyone who cannot use the discount, I will choose a regular ticket and avoid mixing up each person's eligibility conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will choose regular tickets as needed based on each person's separate conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Are you going to the same destination?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。同じ列車に乗りますが、二枚の券の金額が違っても不思議ではありませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同旅程でも二券の価格差を理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. We will take the same train, but it would not be surprising if the two tickets cost different amounts, would it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show that you understand two tickets can have different prices despite the same itinerary. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 条件の回答後に購入できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can purchase them after receiving an answer about the conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。対象者と券を一枚ずつ確認し、それぞれ本人へ渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 対象と券を各人ごとに照合して渡す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will check the eligible person and each ticket one at a time, then give each ticket to its holder.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Match each person with their ticket separately before handing them out. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 資料と二名のご希望を担当へお伝えください。各人の条件を確認してご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please show the documents and explain both people's wishes to the person in charge. We will check each person's conditions and assist you.
